data.name: Ababil
data.gender_notes: Ababil is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Ababil refers to a type of rain sent by Allah (swt) during the time of Prophet Ibrahim (as). It is a sign of Allah's mercy and a reminder of His power. The name Ababil carries the meaning “Rain from the sky” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ababil usually hope their child will grow to embody rain from the sky and live with faith, good character and purpose.
